question: _______ hosted the World Games 2022 in July 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States of America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The World Games **is a multi-sport event held every four years, featuring sports that are not contested in the Olympic Games.
 
• The 2022 World Games is scheduled to be held from July 7 to 17, 2022, in **Birmingham, Alabama, United States**.
 
• Japan hosted the previous edition of the World Games in 2017, which was held in the city of Wrocundefinedaw, Poland.
 
• Germany has never hosted the World Games, although it has participated in every edition of the event since its inception in 1981.
 
• Italy has also never hosted the World Games, although it has won several medals in various sports at the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• The United States of America is a federal republic consisting of 50 states, a federal district, and five major self-governing territories.
 
• The country is the third-largest in the world by both land area and population, with a diverse economy and a rich cultural heritage.
 
• Germany is a federal parliamentary republic in central-western Europe, known for its engineering prowess, cultural landmarks, and historical significance.
 
• Japan is an island country in East Asia, known for its technological advancements, cuisine, and unique cultural traditions.
 
• Italy is a southern European country, known for its rich history, art, architecture, and cuisine. It is also famous for its fashion industry and luxury sports cars.
